title: Fold long user messages in the Claude pane's thread
notes: A user message over about 12 lines (a pasted log) shows its first 6 lines and a "… N more lines" row; a click on it, or the unfold key on the selected entry, opens it, like a tool call. Claude still gets the full text. Only the thread; the box is unchanged. Today chat-entries.ts:152 draws the whole text. Rule in a small module with a test.

comments.body: PR #102 merged: a message you send over 12 lines shows its first 6 lines and a "… N more lines" row that a click or the unfold key opens; Claude still gets the whole text. Images and PDF tiles of a folded message stay visible below the fold.
